# Date and Time Functions

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Now](/docs/standard-library/date-and-time/now) | Gives the current date and time in UTC. |
| [Today](/docs/standard-library/date-and-time/today) | Gives the current date in UTC. |
| [ParseDate](/docs/standard-library/date-and-time/parsedate) | Reads a date written as an ISO 8601 string and gives it in the standard UTC form. |
| [FormatDate](/docs/standard-library/date-and-time/formatdate) | Writes a date as text, following a format pattern. |
| [DateAdd](/docs/standard-library/date-and-time/dateadd) | Adds an amount of a unit of time to a date. |
| [DateDiff](/docs/standard-library/date-and-time/datediff) | Measures the time from one date to another, in a given unit. |
| [DatePart](/docs/standard-library/date-and-time/datepart) | Gives one part of a date, such as its year or its day of the week, as a number. |
